text:
IncidentBot: :rotating_light: ALERT: Canary cluster us-west-2 running model v12 reporting p99 > 5s and streaming stalls detected. Auto-paging to oncall. metric: /dashboards/latency?cluster=us-west-2

Alice (oncall): seeing it. p95 ~ 450ms, p99 ~ 5.6s on canary pods. Streaming clients show stalls ~10-15s then reconnects.

Ben (SRE): confirmed. Topology: 12 canary pods behind alpha-route. Traffic shard ~15% of production. Tail spike coincides with rollout to v12 ~ 18:12 UTC.

Eve (Engineering): I started a quick aggregate of logs. Noting lots of KV cache_miss followed by long kernel exec times. Suspect attention-kernel fallback on certain token lengths.

Carla (Product): Any customer-facing impact? I have 2 SEs flagged — FluxPay (high-traffic customer) reported elevated error rates and higher latencies on streaming sessions.

Zara (Support): FluxPay incident: they've opened a support ticket, their timeout threshold is 8s — several of their sessions retried and caused duplicate charges in their client retry logic. They've asked for ETA.

Alice (oncall): OK we need to mitigate live. Two parallel tracks: 1) immediate traffic remediation (rollback or divert canary) 2) deep triage for root cause. Who can run the rollback?

Dave (Infra): I can do traffic rollback. Recommend set canary traffic to 0 for v12 and re-route to v11. Will need a short deploy command.

Eve (Engineering): Quick verification: v11 doesn't have the new attention kernel and has been stable. Rolling back should remove kernel fallback behavior that's spiking tails.

Ben (SRE): Also advise temporarily increasing streaming idle timeouts to avoid client reconnect storms while we flip traffic.

Alice (oncall): Actioning now. Dave, please execute rollback. Ben, apply timeout change. Zara, please inform FluxPay of actions and estimated time to mitigation. Carla, coordinate messaging for affected customers.

Dave (Infra): running:```bash
# route canary back to v11
rictl rollout set --route canary --model v11 --region us-west-2 --force
```
Executing...

IncidentBot: DeployBot: rollout started for route=canary model=v11 region=us-west-2 by Dave at 18:29:12 UTC.

Ben (SRE): Applying streaming config tweak:
```yaml
streaming_idle_timeout: 30s  # increased from 10s
backoff_retries: 2
```
Applied to alpha-route canary proxies.

Alice (oncall): Dave — any errors?

Dave (Infra): rollback command returned success. New traffic routing confirmed: v11 now serving canary traffic. Live metrics should follow in ~30s.

Eve (Engineering): Watching logs: KV cache miss rate dropping, kernel fallback no longer showing high-latency execs. Early signs good.

IncidentBot: Metric update: p99 dropped from 5.6s -> 700ms over 90s. Streaming stall errors down 92%.

Zara (Support): Notified FluxPay: "We've rolled back the canary model in us-west-2 and applied streaming timeout mitigations. You should see improvements within 2 minutes. We're following up with root cause analysis and a timeline for a safe re-rollout." They replied :thumbsup: and asked for postmortem.

Carla (Product): Notifying affected customers with templated note + contact for escalation. Will prepare postmortem and include repro prompt set for QA.

Ben (SRE): Quick blamestep: probable cause = attention-kernel 3b-opt introduced in v12 that triggers fallback path for sequences > 1024 tokens causing long tail. Need validation in staging with token-length fuzzing.

Eve (Engineering): Agreed. Next steps: add synthetic load with long sequences + KV-heavy patterns, reproduce, and add guardrail to compile-time kernel selection to avoid fallback.

Alice (oncall): Paging complete: customer impact reduced, rollback success. I'm going to hand this to the oncall for the next shift for follow-up and postmortem. Ben/Eve/Carla to own RCA and action items.

Ben (SRE): I'll lead the incident writeup and include telemetry: p50/p95/p99 graphs, streaming error spikes, KV cache miss heatmap, and exact commit hash for v12.

Dave (Infra): I'll add an automation to block automatic canary upgrades until we have a token-length regression test in CI.

Zara (Support): I've updated the ticket for FluxPay with timeline and will schedule a call if they request.

Alice (oncall): Handoff: I'm signing off at 19:00 UTC. Next oncall is Ben. Ben, please ack and take over active follow-ups.

Ben (SRE): ACK. Taking over. Setting incident status -> monitoring. Will publish postmortem draft in incidents channel.

IncidentBot: :white_check_mark: INCIDENT RESOLVED (mitigated): p99 returned to baseline under SLA and customer impact contained. Escalation: postmortem required.

Eve (Engineering): Saving key logs and a sample trace bundle: `/var/logs/ci/incidents/2334506789-tracebundle.zip`

Carla (Product): Adding follow-ups: "re-run rollout with kernel canary off by default", "add canary traffic ramp guard at 5%/10min", "customer communication checklist".

Ben (SRE): Estimated ETA for postmortem: EOD. Will tag owners and lift action items into the runbook board.

Alice (oncall): Thanks team. Leaving final note: if any customer sees regression, page SRE immediately and mention this incident id. :white_check_mark:
